# RwaOracle
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/rwa-oracles/src/RwaOracle.sol)

**Inherits:**
Ownable, [AggregatorV3Interface](./interfaces/aggregator-v3-interface.md), [IRwaOracle](./interfaces/i-rwa-oracle.md), EIP712

**Title:**
RwaOracle

**Author:**
Summer

Chainlink-compatible price oracle for RWA assets with multi-sig price updates.

Implements AggregatorV3Interface for drop-in use with Chainlink consumers.
Price updates require a threshold of valid EIP-712 signatures from authorized signers.
Signatures must be sorted ascending by signer address.


## State Variables
### PRICE_UPDATE_TYPEHASH
EIP-712 typehash for PriceUpdate struct


```solidity
bytes32 public constant PRICE_UPDATE_TYPEHASH =
    keccak256("PriceUpdate(int256 price,uint256 timestamp,uint256 nonce,address oracle,uint256 chainId)")
```

## Functions
### constructor


```solidity
constructor(
    string memory _description,
    address[] memory _signers,
    uint256 _threshold,
    address _owner
)
    Ownable(_owner)
    EIP712("RwaOracle", "1");
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_description`|`string`|Human-readable description of the price feed.|
|`_signers`|`address[]`|Initial list of authorized signer addresses.|
|`_threshold`|`uint256`|Minimum signatures required for price update (must be 1 <= threshold <= signers.length).|
|`_owner`|`address`|Owner address (manages signers and threshold).|


### getRoundData

Get data for a specific round (Chainlink compatibility).


```solidity
function getRoundData(uint80 _roundId)
    external
    view
    returns (uint80 roundId, int256 answer, uint256 startedAt, uint256 updatedAt, uint80 answeredInRound);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_roundId`|`uint80`|Round identifier.|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`roundId`|`uint80`|The round ID.|
|`answer`|`int256`|Price for the round.|
|`startedAt`|`uint256`|Timestamp when the round started.|
|`updatedAt`|`uint256`|Timestamp when the round was updated.|
|`answeredInRound`|`uint80`|Round in which the answer was computed.|


### latestRoundData

Get the latest round data (Chainlink compatibility).


```solidity
function latestRoundData()
    external
    view
    returns (uint80 roundId, int256 answer, uint256 startedAt, uint256 updatedAt, uint80 answeredInRound);
```
**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`roundId`|`uint80`|Latest round ID.|
|`answer`|`int256`|Latest price.|
|`startedAt`|`uint256`|Timestamp of the round.|
|`updatedAt`|`uint256`|Timestamp of the round.|
|`answeredInRound`|`uint80`|Same as roundId.|


### updatePrice

Update the oracle price with multi-sig authorization.

Requires at least `threshold` valid signatures. Reverts on StalePrice, FuturePrice, NotEnoughSignatures,
Unauthorized, InvalidSignature.


```solidity
function updatePrice(int256 price, uint256 timestamp, bytes[] calldata signatures) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`price`|`int256`|New price (8 decimals).|
|`timestamp`|`uint256`|Unix timestamp of the price (must be newer than latest and not in future).|
|`signatures`|`bytes[]`|Array of EIP-712 signatures from authorized signers (sorted ascending by address).|


### _verifySignatures

Verifies that the hash has at least `threshold` valid signatures from unique, sorted signers.


```solidity
function _verifySignatures(bytes32 hash, bytes[] calldata signatures) internal view;
```

### addSigner

Add an authorized signer.


```solidity
function addSigner(address signer) external onlyOwner;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`signer`|`address`|Address to add. Must not be zero or already a signer.|


### removeSigner

Remove a signer.

Reverts if removal would leave fewer signers than threshold. Lower threshold first if needed.


```solidity
function removeSigner(address signer) external onlyOwner;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`signer`|`address`|Address to remove.|


### setThreshold

Set the minimum number of signatures required for price updates.


```solidity
function setThreshold(uint256 _threshold) external onlyOwner;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_threshold`|`uint256`|New threshold. Must be > 0 and <= current signer count.|
